title: Moodboard de Moda 3D Pixar: Diseño de Ropa Urbana con Patrón Geométrico Abstracto
prompt: 4:3 aspect ratio. A professional and detailed fashion Pixar 3D style mood board, presented in a clean, high-resolution style, depicting a slender and tall white female model with 0.6 leg-to-body ratio. The model appears in a standard runway walking pose, stepping forward, showcasing a modern and vibrant streetwear look against a pure white background. The entire outfit features geometric abstract patterns in vibrant colors (coral pink, electric blue, sunshine yellow, and mint green) as the textile design. She wears a unique cropped top with a high mock neck design, geometric cutout on the left shoulder exposing skin, and a thin spaghetti strap on the right side, both adorned with the signature pattern. Over it, she has a loose, boxy bomber-style jacket with dropped shoulders, wide sleeves, and ribbed cuffs. The jacket is based on large areas of coral pink and electric blue geometric patterned fabric, with prominent placement of mint green and yellow pattern fabric splicing, while covered with a layer of unique semi-transparent white fabric flowing ethereally from around the waist, adding layers and dreamy quality. The bottom is a sliced-cut silhouette skirt in light coral pink shade, also incorporating patterned fabric splicing. The entire look is finished with clean white sneakers. The model has deep brown long hair with slight natural waves, freely falling around her shoulders and face. She has delicate features, an oval face shape, understated makeup, natural eyebrows, deep expressive eyes, and soft pink lip color. Her expression is neutral, calm yet confident. The lighting is soft, bright, and even studio photography lighting, bringing gentle sheen to the fabrics and delicately outlining the garment contours and model's features, while casting minimal soft shadows to add depth and dimension. White design canvas dotted with additional design elements: 3-4 minimalist pencil line design sketches distributed on the right side and lower left of the frame. In the upper left corner position, there is an enlarged color detail box showing the precise texture of the fabric pattern. The background is scattered with various handwritten notes and annotations in black ink - designer's comments, bringing the overall professional design concept board visual effect. The overall atmosphere is elegant, artistic, and trend-leading.
